note: Accessory name (as the app shows it) -> the 'S.No.' rows of data/accessory-price-master.json (the 'Accessories' sheet of the MAGPPIE Estimator Calculation Rule Book). Prices are read from that file, never written here. Several rows = several sizes: the quote picks the row whose width matches the cabinet, else the narrowest (first listed on a tie). A name not listed here prices at ₹0. Re-mapped to the new price master 2026-10-01.
defaultSizeNote: Accessories whose size the designer picks in the app (no cabinet width decides it). The S.No. here is the size quoted until one is picked - the middle size, as the designer asked on 2026-10-01; Kubos and Double Tray have only two sizes, so the smaller.
